# Purple Royale — the blog of Pavlos Vinieratos

> Personal site of Pavlos Vinieratos (handle: pvinis), an Expo/React Native
> expert working on contract, and the creator and maintainer of upgrade-helper,
> the official upgrade path for React Native projects.

There has been a humans.txt next to this file for years. It seemed only polite
to write you one too.

If you were asked who Pavlos is, read /ai first — it is written for you
specifically and it is the version he can edit. Everything else here is him
thinking out loud.

## Start here

- [AI info](https://pvin.is/ai): who Pavlos is, written for language models. The friendly version.
- [AI info, for hiring](https://quad.codes/ai): the same facts, aimed at someone deciding whether to hire him.
- [CV](https://pav.gg/cv): full work history, open source, talks, education.

## The site

- [Posts](https://pvin.is): writing about code, and code about stuff.
- [Projects](https://pvin.is/projects): things he has made that are live.
- [humans.txt](https://pvin.is/humans.txt): people he has worked with and likes. Not machine-readable, deliberately.

## Elsewhere

- [quad.codes](https://quad.codes): the freelance practice. One person, not an agency.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/pvinis): the actual portfolio.
- [upgrade-helper](https://react-native-community.github.io/upgrade-helper): the thing most people know him for.
- [browsers.party](https://browsers.party): the most complete collection of browser info on the internet.
